text: still break it easy. Have plane -> click edge -> extrude -> undo -> extrude -> broken [Image #1]
resolution: Fixed the plane edge-extrude → undo → edge-extrude corruption at its real transaction boundary. Part-range normalization now rebases the active native edit scope before rebuilding topology, repeated scope echoes no longer erase the freshly focused edge, and a valid extrusion is never rolled back merely because UI focus could not be restored. Added Zig regression coverage and verified the two extrusion results are byte-identical through the real headless editor journal.
